title: Lord of the Church, We Humbly Pray
description: Lord of the Church, We Humbly Pray in Tonic Solfa to HOLY MATRIMONY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Edward Osler wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 485.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Particular Metre (8.8.6.8.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to HOLY MATRIMONY; any other Common Particular Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Lord of the Church, we hum-bly pray For those who guide us in Thy way And speak Thy ho-ly Word; With love di-vine their hearts in-spire And touch their lips with hal-lowed fire And need-ful strength af-ford.

lines: Lord of the Church, we humbly pray
For those who guide us in Thy way
With love divine their hearts inspire
And touch their lips with hallowed fire
Help them to preach the Truth of God,
On all the Church His gifts to shower,—
To them a messenger of power;
To us, of life and peace.
So may they live to Thee alone;
Then hear the welcome word, “Well done!”
In praise and bliss and love.

licence: Public domain: Edward Osler died in 1863.
credits: Words by Edward Osler (1798–1863), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to HOLY MATRIMONY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
